KEY FACTS:
- SAP ECC is NASA’s core financial system and functions as the central hub for the Agency’s business operations, with SAP ECC reaching its end-of-life in December 2027.
- On October 30, 2023, President Biden signed an Executive Order on the Safe, Secure, and Trustworthy Development and Use of Artificial Intelligence (AI).
- In response to the Executive Order, NASA appointed its first Chief Artificial Intelligence Officer on May 13, 2024.
